top_signals.title: Dollar’s Best Rally Since March Has Legs as Fortunes Shift
top_signals.summary: The dollar is headed for its best two-week stretch in six months in a reversal of fortunes that’s likely to support the currency through the rest of the year, asset managers and strategists say.

top_signals.title: United States on track for record crude oil production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. crude oil production will average 13.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 13.7 million b/d set in 2025, in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: PROSTEP cooperates with Lattice on Data Conversion in Shipbuilding
top_signals.summary: PROSTEP is expanding into the Far East. The Darmstadt-based digital thread expert recently signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Seoul-based Lattice, a company that develops AI solutions for shipbuilding and other industries, to establish a partnership. The goal of the agreement is to establish PROSTEP’s OpenPDM integration technology in the South Korean shipbuilding industry ...
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
top_signals.summary: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry Hub.
